HediffDef.label: uni-health brain chip
HediffDef.description: A neural implant which allows its user to closely track their vitals and other medically-relevant information.\n\nThe chip also seem capable to transmitting and receiving information to a central control station.
HediffDef.descriptionShort: A neural implant which allows its user to closely track their vitals.

li.surgicalDetectionDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} has a chip embedded in {PAWN_possessive} brain. It appears benign now, but {SURGEON_nameDef} is worried about a component attached to it. A highly skilled doctor might be able to remove it.
